# DeepSeek Harness Easy

> Beginner fork of DeepSeek Harness. Install by cloning this git tree and running `pnpm run desktop:install` on macOS. Do not use an unsigned GitHub Release `.command` or `.app` as the install path.

The user-facing install procedure for coding agents is INSTALL.md (Chinese: INSTALL.zh.md).

## Files

- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): clone, pnpm install, build, `pnpm run desktop:install`, first-run API key.
- [INSTALL.zh.md](INSTALL.zh.md): same procedure in Simplified Chinese.
- [README.md](README.md): project overview and the paste-this-to-an-agent prompt.
- [docs/user/guide/index.md](docs/user/guide/index.md): Web UI after the server is running.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): contributor and in-repo agent standing orders.

## Quick commands

```
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/chenrenhan91-art/deepseek-harness-easy.git
cd deepseek-harness-easy
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.7.0 --activate
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm run desktop:install
```

Open the Electron window (default http://127.0.0.1:3080) and paste a DeepSeek API key from https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys

Do not commit or push files produced on the user's machine after install (.env, API keys, HTML pages, lib/, dist/). Keys live in ~/.dsh.
